acceptance_cases.criterion: GIVEN tenant A and B with overlapping object labels WHEN A guesses B IDs through read/write/list/export endpoints THEN all attempts are denied and no B data appears.
evidence: tests/packets/A03/test_ac1_tenant_isolation.py::test_ac1_guessed_ids_denied_on_read_write_delete (owner and member of A; GET/PATCH/DELETE on B's account, strategy and order -> 404; B's rows unchanged)
tests/packets/A03/test_pg_rls.py::test_ac1_rls_tenant_sees_and_touches_only_own_rows (visibility, UPDATE/DELETE rowcount 0, WITH CHECK rejects a smuggled insert, no context -> no rows)
tests/packets/A03/test_pg_rls.py::test_ac2_http_requests_interleaved_on_pooled_connections (full HTTP stack on PostgreSQL as the app role)

acceptance_cases.criterion: GIVEN a pooled DB connection used by A WHEN it serves B next THEN no tenant context survives the transaction boundary.
evidence: tests/packets/A03/test_pg_rls.py::test_ac2_pooled_connection_carries_no_tenant_across_transactions (pool_size=1, same pg_backend_pid: next borrower sees an empty app.tenant_id and no rows, then only B's rows)
tests/packets/A03/test_pg_rls.py::test_ac2_stray_session_level_set_is_reset_on_checkin (a non-local SET is cleared by the pool checkin RESET; negative control fails without it)
tests/packets/A03/test_pg_rls.py::test_ac2_http_requests_interleaved_on_pooled_connections (A/B requests interleaved 5x on a 1+1 pool, pids reused)
acceptance_cases.note: Run against real PostgreSQL 16 locally. CI skips these cases (no PostgreSQL service); they are not claimed on SQLite.

acceptance_cases.criterion: GIVEN a revoked member WHEN an old session makes a privileged request THEN it is rejected within the declared revocation window (target <= 60s).
evidence: tests/packets/A03/test_ac3_revocation.py::test_ac3_revoked_member_old_session_rejected (next request 401, elapsed asserted < 60 s; reads also 401; a fresh login has no tenant and gets 403)

acceptance_cases.criterion: GIVEN a viewer WHEN changing membership or posting a command THEN policy denies the action and records the attempt without secrets.
evidence: tests/packets/A03/test_ac4_viewer_denied.py::test_ac4_viewer_denied_and_attempts_audited_without_secrets (7 attempts -> 403, nothing changed, 7 DENY rows with action, role and tenant; bearer token, password and request body absent from the whole audit table)

acceptance_cases.criterion: Concurrent invite redemption creates one authorized membership; revoked/expired invitations fail; a new member gains no implicit account trading grant.
evidence: tests/packets/A03/test_pg_rls.py::test_ac5_concurrent_redemption_postgres (8 racers on PostgreSQL row locks -> 1 won, 7 x 409)

tests/packets/A03/test_ac5_invites.py::test_ac5_new_member_has_no_implicit_trading_grant (GET /api/me grants [], principal_for -> Principal@1.0 with grants (); grants explicit and audited; viewers can't hold TRADE_*; REPO_WRITE refused by ALLOWED_GRANTS[USER])
